cases.name: signature by a device that is not home
addedBy that is not the signer

description: key-hierarchy design §4.1, §4.3, §5.6, §12 KH1: chains of signed epochs (link, epochSig, carried additions with addSig, home, a takeover's recoverySig). The first verifies (N and K added by the home A during epoch 1; epoch 2 by A removes B and K; epoch 3 hands home to N; epoch 4 is a takeover by the recovery key with K as the new home); the others are the negative vectors: a broken link, a wrong root, an epoch signed by a device that is not home, an addedBy that is not the signer, an epoch introducing a device, a takeover signed by another recovery key. Device keys are the strings age1pq1test-<name>. Written by EpochChainTests.
